description: Search apiwatch's feed of reviewed vendor changes by text: a case-insensitive match on each record's summary, vendor and signatures (the strings to look for in code). Use it when you know a product or feature name but not the exact id. Newest key date first; default 20 results, max 50.

vendor.description: Only this vendor, for example OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Stripe

name: search_changes

date_passed.description: True when the key date is today or earlier (UTC)

scope.description: Empty when the record applies to every caller; otherwise where it applies

title: Search changes
